```{julia}
#| echo: false
include(joinpath(@__DIR__, "benchmarks", "benchmarks.jl"))
results = read_results()
```

Each dataset has a report that fits MLP, ResNet, NeuroTree and TabM with fixed settings and scores them on a held-out test set. Every report run adds its scores to `quarto/benchmarks/results.csv`, tagged with the NeuroTabModels version and git commit.

This page compares, for each dataset, the latest run with the previous run on the same device. A test metric that is more than 2% worse, or a training or prediction time that is more than 25% slower, is flagged. Timings leave out compilation but depend on the machine, so runs are meant to be made on the same one.

To add a run, render the reports with `julia --project=quarto quarto/run.jl`. Add a dataset as a new entry in `DATASETS` in `quarto/benchmarks/benchmarks.jl`.

```{julia}
#| echo: false
# relative change from `prev` to `cur`, signed so that positive is worse
function worse_by(metric, cur, prev)
    prev == 0 && return 0.0
    change = (cur - prev) / abs(prev)
    return metric in HIGHER_IS_BETTER ? -change : change
end

function flag(metric, change)
    metric == "best_iter" && return ""
    limit = metric in ("train_time", "predict_time") ? 0.25 : 0.02
    return change > limit ? "worse" : ""
end

function compare(results, dataset)
    d = results[results.dataset .== dataset, :]
    runs = unique(select(sort(d, :date), :date, :version, :commit, :device), [:version, :commit, :device])
    run_name(r) = "$(r.version) ($(r.commit), $(r.device))"
    cur = runs[end, :]
    runs = runs[runs.device .== cur.device, :]
    d = d[d.device .== cur.device, :]
    out = DataFrame(; model=String[], metric=String[])
    out[!, run_name(cur)] = Float64[]
    if nrow(runs) == 1
        for r in eachrow(d[d.commit .== cur.commit, :])
            push!(out, (r.model, r.metric, r.value))
        end
        return out
    end
    prev = runs[end - 1, :]
    out[!, run_name(prev)] = Float64[]
    out[!, "worse by"], out.flag = String[], String[]
    for r in eachrow(d[d.commit .== cur.commit, :])
        p = d[(d.commit .== prev.commit) .& (d.model .== r.model) .& (d.metric .== r.metric), :value]
        isempty(p) && continue
        change = worse_by(r.metric, r.value, only(p))
        push!(out, (r.model, r.metric, r.value, only(p), string(round(100 * change; digits=1), "%"), flag(r.metric, change)))
    end
    return out
end
```

```{julia}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
for dataset in sort(unique(results.dataset))
    println("## ", dataset, "\n")
    println("[Report](benchmark-", dataset, ".md). ", DATASETS[dataset].description, "\n")
    println(markdown_table(compare(results, dataset)), "\n")
end
```
